verses.1: And I saw an angel descending from heaven, holding a crown of thorns on his head, with a large wreath of flowers also on his hand.
verses.2: And he defeated the dragon, that ancient monster, who is also known as Diablos and Satan. He kept him in captivity for thousands of years.
verses.3: And he put him into the abyss. He sealed and trapped him there, so that no more nations would be scattered from there, until after thousands of years had passed. After that, it will take some time for him to be freed from that state.
verses.4: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them. And they were given judgment. The souls of those who were condemned by the testimony of Jesus and by God’s word were destroyed. Those who did not worship the beast or its image, and who did not receive the mark on their foreheads or on their hands, lived and ruled for thousands of years after Christ’s death.
verses.5: The rest of the dead did not live until the completion of thousands of years. This was the first resurrection.
verses.6: He who has a share in the first resurrection is truly great and holy. In this way, the second death has no power over them. They will become priests of God and Christ, and they will reign with him for thousands of years.
verses.7: And when the thousand years are over, Satan will be released from his prison.
verses.8: And he will lead the nations that are located in the four directions of the earth into war. The number of these nations is like the amount of sand in the sea.
verses.9: And they ascended to the height of the earth. They circled around the holy places and the beloved city. Then, fire came down from heaven and consumed them.
verses.10: And the devil, the one who leads them astray, will be thrown into the lake of fire and brimstone. There, both the monster and the false prophet will be tormented day and night forever.
verses.11: And we saw a huge white throne, and those who sat upon it; from their faces, the earth and heaven were hidden. They couldn’t find any place where they could sit.
verses.12: And we saw the dead, both the old and the young, lying before the throne. There were also books opened up; another book was opened up, and that is the book of life. The dead were judged according to what was written in those books, based on their actions.
verses.13: And the sea gave over its dead bodies to those who were in it. And death and Hades also gave over their dead bodies to those who were in them. Then each one was punished according to his own actions.
verses.14: And death and darkness were thrown into the pool of fire. This is the second form of death—the pool of fire.
verses.15: And if anyone isn’t found written in the book of life, then they will be thrown into the lake of fire.
